body: Source: decision 0523 (docs/decisions/0523-cem-1-0-rc3-verifier-computed-support-2026-10-11.md) and build-log docs/build-log/2026-10-11-cem-1-0-expert-panel.md, origin/main fb11b2274. Proposed CEM-V1-060..062. Per hunk exactly one tier: held, mechanical-proved, anchored, cited, unknown, plus an `annotation` flag. `anchored` is derived from base blob, target blob and canonical patch only, kinds `id` (ASCII requirement ID defined by the cited span with the `- `ID`:` prefix) and `path`; the Go-only `symbol` kind is a recorded limit. The result gains hunksByClass, distinctEvidence, ordered evidenceFanOut, maxFanOut, samePathCitations, concentratedHunks, and the cyclic-shift `invariant`/`specificity` pair. No value is pass/fail. No wire change. Earliest proof: the report over the 591 committed maps is the first deliverable (expected about 0 held, about half invariant). Related: V1-0195 (hunk-anchored review projection).
